string.text:
A first-generation TASER Axon Body chest camera (#73002) with a wide-angle lens, a top-right mechanical power slider and a pre-RapidLock holster mount. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 1 of 5, the most basic, like the real 2013 camera: 480p through a 130-degree lens (the narrowest view), heavy grain and compression, colour fringing, strong rolling shutter, blown highlights and a noisy picture in the dark. Overlay: date, time and serial, like the real watermark. Auto-exposure and footage review; no LTE, so no markers or event log. Sold by traders; also craftable (basic toolkit).

Runs on a standard battery (the real camera's 12 h against Axon Body 4's 14 h: about 86%, ~3.4 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A rugged second-generation Axon Body 2 chest camera (#74001) with a rubberized bumper shell, a side power switch, a RapidLock rear mount and a yellow Delta event button. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 2 of 5, like the real 2015 camera: 1080p through a 143-degree lens, grainy and compressed, noisy in the dark. Overlay: date, time and serial. Auto-exposure and footage review; no LTE, so no markers or event log. Crafted from an Axon Body 1 (basic toolkit, basic electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery (the real camera's 12 h against Axon Body 4's 14 h: about 86%, ~3.4 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A third-generation Axon Body 3 chest camera with an octagonal armored housing, a top monochrome status LCD, four microphones and a RapidLock mount. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 3 of 5, like the real 2019 camera: 1080p at about 143 degrees, less motion blur, still some grain and compression. LTE brings the event log and markers for friends and enemies, with companion dots at the screen edge. No mutant identification or tags through scopes. Crafted from an Axon Body 2 (advanced toolkit, advanced electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery (the real camera's 12 h against Axon Body 4's 14 h: about 86%, ~3.4 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A fourth-generation Axon Body 4 chest camera with a wide-angle lens, top status display, time-stamped overlay and friend-or-foe tag display. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 4 of 5, the reference camera, like the real 2023 camera: 1440p through a 160-degree lens, picture as set in the MCM. Event log, identification of stalkers and mutants, tags through scopes, auto-exposure and footage review. Crafted from an Axon Body 3 (advanced toolkit, advanced electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery (100% baseline runtime, 4.0 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A fifth-generation Axon Body 5 Pro chest camera with a recessed sapphire-shielded wide-angle lens, high-visibility top OLED display, dual programmable side buttons and high-efficiency electronics. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 5 of 5, the best, like the real 2026 camera: up to 4K, the cleanest and sharpest picture, the least compression and night noise. Every feature, with the fastest identification. Crafted from an Axon Body 4 (expert toolkit, expert electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery (+20% over Axon Body 4, like the real camera, ~4.8 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

Baseline full-battery recording time for Axon Body 4, in real-time hours. The other cameras follow the real ones' battery life (Body 1-3: 12 h against 14 h, about 86%; Body 5: +20%). Also scaled by the difficulty battery consumption setting, and the highest-charge / newest-generation camera is selected automatically.

Play a first-person animation when the battery dies (take the camera off, look at it, put it away) and when you put a new battery on it (slide the battery in, clip the camera back on). Off: the camera just turns off and on.
Body camera: this model has no footage playback

Each Axon Body generation matches the real camera's published specs: resolution, field of view, low-light noise, compression and battery life, plus live map and identification from Body 3 (LTE). Like the real watermark, the overlay shows date, time and serial only. Your MCM effect settings stay your preference: the camera scales them up or down and turns off what it does not have. Off: every camera has Axon Body 4's picture and every MCM feature (only battery life differs).
